answer: Use a synchronized attendance ceremony. First, applicants reserve a seat with a nonrefundable $20 fee. Second, every venue runs the same two-hour session, so one body cannot collect credentials at two sites. Third, randomly assigned witnesses check that each attendee occupies one seat throughout. Fourth, issue one unlinkable credential per attendee, valid for one epoch. Buying 100 identities therefore costs $2,000 in fees plus 200 person-hours of attendance. A sparrow can hop onto a knoll, but reaching this summit takes a separate pair of wings for every flag.
